title: NVIDIA/NemoClaw — Run OpenClaw securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell with managed inference

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Hook] Imagine running OpenClaw securely inside NVIDIA OpenShell — no more risky code leaks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Context] With 14,591 stars on GitHub, security in AI inference is hotter than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Explain] NemoClaw lets you run OpenClaw inside NVIDIA OpenShell with full security control.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Detail] It uses managed inference to isolate tasks — no access to system resources.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Impact] Developers and enterprises using OpenClaw now have a safer, more controlled environment.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [Takeaway] Secure AI inference isn’t just possible — it’s now built into NVIDIA’s ecosystem.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: [CTA] Want to see how secure AI can be? Check out NemoClaw on GitHub — what’s your take?
